name: LangSmith
tagline: Observability and deployment for AI agents
description: LangSmith is LangChain's platform for tracing, evaluating and deploying AI applications, priced per seat plus pay-as-you-go usage.
features: Trace retention of 14 days (base) or 180 days (extended)
Deployments, sandboxes and an engine metered in LangChain Standard Units
Cloud data location in the US or EU
Self-hosted and hybrid options for Enterprise
strengths: Cloud data can be located in the US or the EU
limitations: Usage beyond the included allowance is pay-as-you-go
Tuned Evaluators are in public beta for Plus and Cloud Enterprise in the US only

plans.name: Developer
highlights: Up to 5k base traces per month

plans.name: Plus
highlights: Up to 10k base traces per month
limits: Up to 10k base traces per month, then pay as you go

free.details: Developer: $0 per seat per month, 1 seat, up to 5k base traces per month, then pay-as-you-go. Community support.

api.summary: Usage is metered in LangChain Standard Units (LSU) at $1.00 each. Developer includes 7 LSUs per organisation per month for Fleet and Plus includes 37.

pricing.regional: Currency shown as '$' without a code. Tax treatment: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Developer $0 per seat/month (1 seat, up to 5k base traces/month, then pay as you go); Plus $39 per seat/month (up to 10k base traces/month, unlimited seats can be added); Enterprise custom. Usage in LangChain Standard Units at $1.00 each. Startup credits up to $10,000 offered.

keyFeature: Tracing, evaluating and deploying AI applications

profile.headline: A platform for observing, evaluating and deploying AI agents

capabilities.title: See what your agents are doing
capabilities.text: Observability traces agents step by step so you can open any run.

capabilities.title: Score and improve performance
capabilities.text: Evaluation turns expert review into standardised evals.

capabilities.title: Ship and run agents in production
capabilities.text: Deployment offers 30+ Agent Server endpoints and one deployment pattern across an organisation.

capabilities.title: Run agent-written code safely
capabilities.text: Sandboxes execute agent-generated code in isolation.

featureCards.name: Engine
featureCards.text: Detects production issues, helps find root causes and feeds fixes back into the eval loop.

featureCards.name: LLM Gateway
featureCards.text: Controls model calls, spend and sensitive data.

featureCards.name: Online evals and alerts
featureCards.text: Dashboards and alerts for cost, latency, errors and tool behaviour.

featureCards.name: Human approval
featureCards.text: Sensitive agent actions can require a person's sign-off.

audienceDetail.text: Teams that ship agents and need to see how they behave.
Groups that run evaluation and deployment as a routine.
The site cites thousands of active customers and Fortune 10 companies.

scenarios.title: Trace a failing run

scenarios.title: Turn review into evals
scenarios.text: Convert expert feedback into tests you can rerun.

scenarios.title: Watch production cost and latency
scenarios.text: Use dashboards and alerts after launch.

scenarios.title: Control model spend
scenarios.text: Route calls through the gateway with limits.
